instruction: Open and stream this video link using VLC media player: https://demo.unified-streaming.com/k8s/features/stable/video/tears-of-steel/tears-of-steel.ism/.m3u8

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires streaming a demo HLS video URL in VLC. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric which checks VLC status for URL playback. Same difficulty as original.
metadata.verification_notes: Reuses existing VLC evaluator functions. Tears of Steel is a known test video stream.

llm_judge_reasons: Launch command correctly includes '--extraintf=http --http-password=password' which enables VLC HTTP interface
Getter get_vlc_playing_info can successfully access http://{vm_ip}:{vlc_port}/requests/status.xml with proper authentication
Metric is_vlc_playing has robust URL verification logic with multiple fallback strategies for HLS streams
Metric correctly handles .m3u8 files with filename matching, direct URL matching, and domain/path matching
Expected parameter handling is correct - metric receives rules dict directly and accesses rule['type'] and rule['url']
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both that VLC is playing AND the correct URL is loaded
Proper error handling and logging throughout getter and metric functions
